veranderings.blok: 'n Dier hang van sy mense af
veranderings.voor: Dit kan ook nie in woorde
veranderings.na: Hy kan ook nie in woorde
veranderings.rede: The pronoun switches from 'Dit' to 'hy' within one sentence; the lesson otherwise refers to the animal as 'hy'.

veranderings.na: het net soveel sorg nodig as 'n troeteldier.
veranderings.rede: Without 'as ...' the comparison is incomplete and 'net soveel' can be misread as 'only so much care'.

veranderings.voor: as jy sien iets is fout met die dier
veranderings.na: as jy sien dat iets met die dier fout is
veranderings.rede: Spoken main-clause order in a subordinate clause; standard written Afrikaans uses 'dat' with the verb at the end.

veranderings.voor: Dit lyk dalk stiller. Tog ly die dier ook.
veranderings.na: Dit gebeur dalk stiller, maar die dier ly ook.
veranderings.rede: 'Dit lyk stiller' is wooden (something cannot look quieter); joining the two short sentences with 'maar' reads more naturally, with the AWS comma.

veranderings.voor: Die wet noem ook uitdruklik om
veranderings.na: Die wet sê ook uitdruklik dat dit verbode is om
veranderings.rede: 'noem' cannot take an 'om ... te' infinitive as object; the sentence as written is ungrammatical.
'Laat ... in hulle eie plek' copies English 'leave them in their place'; Afrikaans 'laat' needs a verb here.
The previous sentence refers to the DBV as 'dit', so 'Sy' is an unclear pronoun reference.
Animals do not 'kry 'n veearts'; they get a vet's care, which is what the sentence means.

veranderings.voor: plekke wat seer wilde diere versorg
veranderings.na: plekke wat beseerde wilde diere versorg
veranderings.rede: 'seer' used attributively before a noun phrase reads unnaturally; 'beseerde' is the normal adjective for injured animals.

veranderings.voor: Iemand wie se werk is om
veranderings.na: Iemand wie se werk dit is om
veranderings.rede: The construction 'wie se werk dit is om' needs the placeholder 'dit'.

vlae.teks: Die bande en rieme waarmee 'n dier aan 'n kar vasgemaak word.
vlae.rede: 'bande' most often means tyres in Afrikaans, and the cart next to it invites that reading; a better word for the straps depends on what the harness is meant to include, so it is flagged rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die doel is om so 'n dier terug te laat gaan
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'terug te laat gaan' names no destination (back to the wild/its natural habitat), which reads incomplete; the protected wording is left intact, but a person may want to consider whether the destination should be stated.
